meta.title: Short Drama Studio
meta.description: The sidebar is configuration only: storyboard rules, Gemini model, the Xiaoyunque (pippit-tool-cli) / Jimeng (dreamina) official CLIs and their models, and the download folder. Real work happens through agent tools (storyboard_write, short_drama_assets, video_submit, video_status, video_download, video_cancel) that submit with each CLI's real syntax, poll and download, all rooted at the current workspace.
